# Controlled archive fixtures

All archival operations and recovery tags occur in disposable repositories with isolated Git identity/signing configuration. The fixture supplies explicit fictional manifest review/approval for apply cases. It never represents actual project human review. Default tests invoke no models.

Apply success includes a fulfilled Intention, one entire clear Exploration with a resolved ticket and executable asset, a subject review to co-delete, and a cross-cutting review to move. A live Intention references the terminal Intention; an old ledger record remains. The required result is three new records and byte/mode recovery from the annotated tag. Dirty and malformed-input cases must delete nothing. Classification also includes unknown/deferred/orphan/failed-Spec-verification cases and a published-doc-linked review.
